SR148 Ferm Living (fermliving.com, DK/EU storefront, verified genuinely separate from SR73 fermliving.us per notes/148.md). Set localization=DK cookie first. Searched collections.json (186 total collections, full page) for New-Arrivals-family keywords (new-arriv/new-in/just-in/latest/news/nyhed) - found only 'news' (302) and 'kids-news' (12), both handled by the same theme template used for the Sale tier. Fetched the rendered pages for both: HTTP 200 but both render the identical placeholder -

Something Special is on the Horizon

This content is currently unavailable. Stay tuned, as we look forward to sharing it with you soon.

- with ZERO products actually listed (no /products/ links, no grid). Neither /collections/news nor /collections/kids-news is linked anywhere in the homepage's live navigation markup (regex scan of nav hrefs for news/new-arriv found nothing; only /pages/newsletter-page matched 'news' as a substring, which is an email-signup page, not a product listing). Probed guessed alternate URL shapes (/collections/new-arrivals, /collections/new-in, /collections/new) - all 404. Site search for 'new arrivals' (English) returned 0 results ('Search: 0 results found'), also checked as supporting evidence per brief (a zero search result alone is not proof, but combined with the 404s and the placeholder-gated 'news' collections it corroborates absence). CONCLUSION: no currently-accessible New Arrivals PLP exists - the closest concept, 'News'/'Kids News', exists in the catalogue/sitemap with non-zero backend counts but the page itself is gated behind an explicit 'currently unavailable' placeholder and isn't live to visitors. This exactly matches SR73's (fermliving.us) identical finding for the same collections, now independently confirmed on this separate .com/DK Shopify instance too - strengthening the read that this is a deliberate, brand-wide, not-yet-launched merchandising tier rather than a one-off glitch. Recording as no valid PLP found (empty rows) rather than fabricating rows for content not actually listed; worth rechecking on a later pass in case the rollout completes.
